caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate candlestick holder that appears to be made of transparent glass or crystal. The base of the candlestick is hexagonal with beveled edges, and it is rendered in varying shades of green and yellow, creating a translucent effect. The stem of the candlestick features a detailed fish motif; the fish is vertically curved with its tail fin upwards and its head facing forward. The body of the fish is decorated with scale patterns, and the fish appears to be emerging from the surface of the base. The top of the candlestick is flared and faceted to hold a candle, continuing the greenish, glass-like coloring. The background is plain and off-white with some spots of discoloration and faint pencil marks, including a partial rectangle around the candlestick and a small handwritten measurement at the bottom of the base.
title: Dolphin Candlestick
